children: Onity Group filed for a declaratory judgment seeking clarity on how a New York mortgage servicing regulation applies to optional expedited payment fees.
Filed declaratory judgment in U.S. District Court (N.D. New York) to clarify application of NY mortgage servicing rule.
Dispute centers on undefined phrase “reasonably related to the cost of rendering that service” for expedited payment fees.
Says fees are optional, customers informed of free alternatives, and company has reduced/eliminated fees for online and automated phone payments.
Onity has cooperated with regulators, is engaged in discussions, and seeks a court to establish a clearly defined standard.
